info.title: Mycelium Network API
info.description:
The Mycelium Network API provides access to corporate entity data and their carbon emissions disclosures. Use it to search for entities by name, LEI, ISIN, BIC, registration number, and country code then retrieve their disclosure history including scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions.

## Typical workflow

1. **Search for an entity** — call `GET /v1/entities/search` with a name, identifier, or country code to find matching entities.
2. **Get entity details** — use the `id` from the search results to call `GET /v1/entities/{id}` for the full entity profile including identifiers, addresses, and classifications.
3. **Retrieve disclosures** — call `GET /v1/entities/{id}/disclosures` to get the entity's carbon emissions disclosures, optionally filtered by reporting year.
4. **Get disclosure detail** — use a disclosure `id` to call `GET /v1/disclosures/{id}` for the full breakdown of emissions by scope.

## Licensing

Use of Mycelium data is governed by licence:

- **Commercial use** — integration into products, services, client-facing applications or internal tools — requires the [Mycelium Commercial API Licence](https://mycelium.global/commercial-api-licence-v1)
- **Non-commercial academic and research use** is covered by the [Academic API Licence](https://mycelium.global/academic-api-licence-v1)
- **Carbon accountants** should see the [Carbon Accountant API Licence](https://mycelium.global/carbon-accountant-api-licence-v1)

Data is provided under Mycelium's [published methodology](https://mycelium.global/methodology). Emissions figures are tagged as company-reported or Mycelium-estimated, and estimates must not be presented as company disclosures.

API keys are issued per user with daily rate limits. Request access at [mycelium.global](https://mycelium.global).

get.description: Retrieve one disclosure by its public id (a UUID): the full per-scope emissions breakdown for a single reporting period, with provenance and scoring.
Retrieve the total number of disclosures currently in the database.
Retrieve the full profile for one entity by its public id (a UUID returned by the search endpoint): identifiers, registration, classifications, addresses, and alternative names.

classifications.description: Retail sale in non-specialised stores with food, beverages or tobacco predominating

get.description: Search the entity register by name, LEI, ISIN, BIC, registration number, country code, or industry classification. Returns a paged list of lightweight entity summaries; use a result's `id` with the other endpoints to retrieve the full profile and its disclosures.
Retrieve the carbon emissions disclosures for one entity by its public id, optionally filtered by reporting year. Returns a paged list; each disclosure carries its per-scope emission lines in kgCO2e.

ApiKey.description: All API requests require an API key passed in the `X-Api-Key` header. Keys are issued per-user and subject to daily rate limits. Contact the Mycelium team to request access.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key

tags.name: Entities
tags.description: Search and retrieve corporate entities. Each entity represents a legal body. Entities can be looked up by name, LEI, ISIN, BIC, registration number, or country code. The full entity profile includes identifiers, registered addresses, classifications, and alternative names.

tags.name: Disclosures
tags.description: Access carbon emissions disclosures. A disclosure represents a single reporting period's emissions data for an entity, broken down by scope (1, 2, and 3). Disclosures can be retrieved for a specific entity via the entities endpoint, or looked up directly by their public id. All emissions values are in kgCO2e.
